summary.heading: Import finished
summary.keptBoth_one: {{count}} song kept next to the existing one
summary.keptBoth_other: {{count}} songs kept next to the existing ones

unsupportedFileType.title: This file type is not supported yet

emptyFile.title: The file is empty
emptyFile.hint: Pick a file that contains a score.

fileTooLarge.title: The file is too large
fileTooLarge.hint: Files can be up to {{limitMb}} MB. Try a smaller file.

unpackedTooLarge.title: The score is too large once unpacked
unpackedTooLarge.hint: Export a smaller score, or fewer parts, from your notation program.

archiveCorrupted.title: The compressed file is damaged
archiveCorrupted.hint: Export the score again, as .mxl or as plain .musicxml.

archiveWithoutScore.title: No score was found inside the compressed file
archiveWithoutScore.hint: Export the score again from your notation program.

xmlMalformed.title: The file is damaged or incomplete
xmlMalformed.hint: Export the score again; the file may have been cut off.

notAScore.title: This is not a MusicXML score
notAScore.hint: Choose a file exported as MusicXML from your notation program.

scoreWithoutMusic.title: The score has no music in it
scoreWithoutMusic.hint: Check that the score has at least one part with measures.

fileUnreadable.title: The file could not be read
fileUnreadable.hint: Pick the file again, or copy it to your device first.

storageFull.title: There is not enough space on this device
storageFull.hint: Free some space or delete songs you no longer need, then try again.

storageFailed.title: The song could not be saved
storageFailed.hint: Try again. If it keeps failing, restart the app.

unexpectedError.title: Something went wrong
unexpectedError.hint: Try the file again. If it keeps failing, it may not be a valid score.

duplicates.heading_one: This song is already in your library
duplicates.heading_other: {{count}} songs are already in your library
duplicates.explanation: Choose one action for all of them. Replace existing swaps their scores for the new files, keep both adds the new files as separate songs, and skip duplicates changes nothing.
